title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When adding more features to a model, it can lead to overfitting. Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, including its noise and outliers, which may not generalize well to new data.

title: Training vs. Testing Error
text: If the training error decreases but the testing error increases, it suggests that the model is fitting the training data too closely and not generalizing well to unseen data.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: The bias-variance tradeoff is a fundamental concept in machine learning. High variance models tend to overfit the training data, while high bias models tend to underfit.
